project.topic: What if social media didn't exist for 5 seconds in 2026?
project.title: What if social media didn't exist for 5 seconds in 2026?
project.audience: Curious international viewers; a playful technology thought experiment in one cafe.
project.core_question: How would six different people react inside the same five seconds without social media?
project.viewer_takeaway: A creator, commuter, seller, gamer, friend and angry commenter face six distinct interruptions during one simultaneous five-second window.

captions.style: Inter Bold uppercase impact phrases with dark outline and shadow, 2-5 words, max two balanced lines
captions.active_word_treatment: Active word in solar yellow #FACC15 with a subtle scale lift.
captions.highlights_policy: The physical consequence of each scene in accent colour; at most two emphasis phrases per scene.

audio.voice_style: Crisp, urgent, fascinated adult male; high-tension simulation narrator; brisk opening cadence
audio.music_direction: Brisk comic electronic pulse with contrasting city textures and a 0.3 second drop before the final empty-send payoff.
audio.sfx_direction: Physical taps, controller clicks, a local game dodge and one SMS ping; no global alarm or destruction.

scientific_model.baseline_reality: Social-platform feeds, livestreams and platform messaging depend on their services; they are not the whole internet or carrier SMS.
scientific_model.counterfactual_change: For exactly five seconds in 2026, all social apps, sites, feeds, livestreams and platform DMs are unavailable everywhere. The film stays entirely inside this window.
assumptions: The broader internet, electricity, ordinary carrier SMS and a selected standalone game remain operational.
Generic social interfaces disappear to empty device surfaces immediately; no real brand inventory or outage implementation is asserted.
Six authored people in Tokyo, London, Lagos, Sao Paulo, Mumbai and New York react during the same window. These are individual possibilities, not universal or culturally representative predictions.
Each location replays part of the same 0-4.9 seconds; film time expands and crosscuts these parallel moments. No restoration, later behavior or aftermath is shown.
The birthday SMS is prewritten and ready to send, so switching channels fits five seconds. All messages are CGI; no external communication occurs.
The game is standalone, not a social-platform game, and continues independently of livestream chat.
causal_chain: Social-platform functions vanish while unrelated device/network functions remain.
A creator keeps a dance pose while the livestream disappears; a commuter makes failed refresh attempts.
A seller loses a platform order but a nearby customer points at food.
A gamer loses chat while the independent game continues, then dodges a visible ambush.
A friend sends an already prepared birthday wish by carrier SMS.
An angry commenter taps the missing send target; the reply reaches nobody during the window.
uncertainties: Actual service outages do not normally remove every local app interface at once; the empty interfaces are the selected fictional change.
No prediction of global panic, revenue loss, permanent restraint, habit change or benefit is made.
City-inspired generic sets do not reconstruct real locations; no precise local time or population behavior is asserted.

claims.statement: All social-platform functions are unavailable for a stipulated five seconds.
claims.reasoning: This is the user-supplied counterfactual, not a measured outage forecast.
claims.presentation_guardrail: Never show recovery or extend actions beyond elapsed 4.9 seconds.

claims.statement: A social platform being unavailable need not disable the broader internet.
claims.reasoning: Meta describes its own backbone/server/DNS outage and disconnection from the broader internet; this scenario holds other infrastructure intact.
claims.presentation_guardrail: Keep internet continuity explicit as a chosen condition, not a universal outage guarantee.

claims.statement: Ordinary carrier SMS is a distinct channel from social-platform messaging.
claims.reasoning: Twilio documents SMS separately from WhatsApp and Messenger. The counterfactual retains the carrier network and a prewritten SMS.
claims.presentation_guardrail: Label ordinary text/SMS distinctly; do not depict a surviving social DM.

claims.statement: Six different individual reactions can occur during the same short interval.
claims.reasoning: Each reaction is authored fiction; the edit presents parallel examples rather than a global behavioral statistic.
claims.presentation_guardrail: Show physical actions in each distinct situation, not a narrated list or stereotypes.

claims.statement: The selected standalone game continues when its separate streaming chat disappears.
claims.reasoning: The game is explicitly independent of the removed social services and runs locally in the chosen scenario.
claims.presentation_guardrail: Do not claim every game, login or network service survives.

sources.name: Meta Engineering: platform backbone outage details
Twilio: distinct SMS and app messaging channels

creative_direction.logline: Six parallel comic interruptions inside the same five seconds: lost audience, futile refresh, physical order, ongoing game, SMS workaround and an unsent angry reply.
creative_direction.visual_identity: Six distinct city-inspired miniature sets; original generic UI on real metre-scale devices. Match cuts connect interrupted hands, not one cafe plot.
creative_direction.lighting: Tokyo evening cyan/pink practicals; London cool daylight; Lagos warm market daylight; Sao Paulo monitor light; Mumbai warm window light; New York cool morning desk light.
creative_direction.camera_language: Eye-level medium reactions alternate with close physical device/action inserts. All camera timing is in numeric storyboard keyframes.
creative_direction.motion_language: Finite dance-to-hesitation, two failed taps, customer pointing, controller dodge, SMS switch and a rejected send. Supported characters and props.
creative_direction.world_scale_policy: Metres. Devices keep normal phone, tablet and monitor dimensions; camera magnifies important actions.
creative_direction.opening_hook: A creator keeps dancing while the livestream vanishes.
creative_direction.mid_video_rehook: The chat disappears but the game keeps running; the gamer visibly dodges an ambush instead of facing a total internet blackout.
creative_direction.ending_payoff: The angry reply is ready but its send button is gone: its perfect audience is absolutely nobody, during these same five seconds.
creative_direction.loop_connection: The empty send target visually rhymes with the opening empty livestream phone, without restoring apps or adding aftermath.
creative_direction.asset_policy: Reuse registered RoomBox furniture, Humanoid, grounded motion, modeling helpers, CityStreet backdrop and existing rendering/audio/caption kits. Story-local devices and game staging remain in the story folder.

distribution.primary_search_intent: What happens during five seconds without social media in a technology thought experiment?
distribution.distinctive_angle: Six contrasting individuals around the globe, all inside the same five seconds; no recovery scene and no cafe moral lesson.
distribution.comment_bait_question: Which would you do first: refresh, switch to SMS, keep playing, or try to send anyway?
distribution.seo_integrity_note: City reactions are authored examples, not statistics; describe social-platform removal separately from total internet failure.
